data.one_liner: Decode Json Web Tokens and check expiration status without a password.
data.what_it_does: Decodes JSON Web Tokens (JWT) base64-encoded headers and payloads into a Map. Provides utility methods to check if a token is expired, retrieve its expiration date, check token age, and get remaining time.
use_when: You need to inspect JWT payload data on the client side
You need to check token expiration or remaining time in Dart or Flutter
avoid_when: You need to cryptographically verify or sign JWT signatures on the client
strengths: Works across all platforms including Dart-only environments
Simple static methods for quick decoding and expiration checks
weaknesses: Does not verify the cryptographic signature of the token
Throws FormatException on invalid tokens instead of returning null
